item.title: Business Data Scientist, YouTube Ads, Finance Revenue Analytics and Forecasting - Youtube
item.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
### **Minimum qualifications:**
* Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Engineering, Sciences, or equivalent practical experience. * 3 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or a relevant PhD degree.
### **Preferred qualifications:**
* 4 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or a relevant PhD degree. * Experience involving quantitative data analysis related to online advertising and emerging businesses. * Strong problem solving and technical abilities to drive forecasting, data analysis, and insights for executive audiences (e.g., SQL, R, Python, dashboard creation, advanced financial modeling, statistics, programming), with attention to detail. * Strong communication skills (e.g., slide decks, live presentations) to distill information concisely to executive audiences.
**About the job** -----------------
The YouTube Ads Finance team provides strategic, financial, and quantitative guidance across YouTube’s core business generation channels. As a Business Data Scientist on the Revenue Analytics team, you will sit at the intersection of data science, financial forecasting, and product strategy.
In this role, you will design statistical models, build business intelligence frameworks, and translate complex datasets into actionable strategic narratives. Your work will directly inform high-stakes decision-making by YouTube executive leadership, guiding business growth within the YouTube Ads Brand advertising business. This role will drive analysis highlighting how product changes, advertiser behavior, and market economics impact YouTube business, and own business forecasting and reporting for a significant portion of the YouTube Ads business.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
US: $138000 - $197000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits
Learn more about benefits at Google.
**Responsibilities** --------------------
* Develop, validate, and maintain advanced forecasting models and predictive frameworks to project global ad revenue trajectories. * Conduct empirical analysis on ad business generation streams to identify growth drivers, advertiser behavior shifts, and yield optimization opportunities. * Partner cross-functionally with YouTube Product, Engineering, and Global Sales Operations to model the financial impact of platform launches, algorithm updates, and policy shifts. * Design scalable data pipelines and executive performance dashboards to monitor business health metrics and ecosystem changes. * Deliver compelling, narrative-driven quantitative presentations to executive leadership, translating complex statistical analyses into concise strategy recommendations.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. item.title: Staff Data Scientist - PayPal
item.description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

item.title: Data Scientist - Intelligent Experiences, MLO - Apple
item.description:
Do you believe machine learning and AI can change the world? We do. We're the ML Data team within Apple's Intelligent System Experience (ISE) group, and we build the high-quality, high-scale datasets that train the ML features across many Apple products - iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and AirPods. Our work sits behind some of the most visible and personal experiences Apple ships: the wallpaper on your Lock Screen, personalized stickers in iMessage, on-device Genmoji and other Apple Intelligence generative models, and models that recognize faces and build memories of the people you love in Photos.
We're looking for a data scientist who's passionate about ML data and excited to shape the training data behind Apple's next generation of multi-modal features. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings rigorous scientific reasoning and owns problems end-to-end.
Join us and you’ll shape shipping products from your first week, working with petabytes of multi-modal data.
**Description**
You will design and operate the end-to-end data lifecycle that supports training, fine-tuning, and evaluation of large language models and diffusion models. Day to day, that means building distributed pipelines that clean, deduplicate, and enrich massive multi-modal datasets; standing up synthetic data generation pipelines with LLM-based generators, validators, and judges; and engineering agentic workflows - multi-step, tool-using LLM systems - that scale human judgment across far more data than a human team could review directly.","responsibilities":"Design synthetic data generation pipelines - prompt/context engineering, generator/critic loops, diversity and contamination controls and prove the data's impact on model quality through controlled ablations
Engineer agentic workflows (multi-step, tool-using, multi-agent LLM systems) or LLM-based flows (RAG, fine tuning) for curation, annotation, labeling QA, and evaluation, with human-in-the-loop checkpoints where they matter
Define and run quality evaluation for synthetic assets: perceptual and reference-based metrics alongside VLM judges and human preference studies
Fine-tune and evaluate LLMs and diffusion models for specific downstream tasks; run controlled ablations that isolate the contribution of each data intervention
Partner cross-functionally with modeling, product, and privacy/legal teams to translate data tradeoffs into decisions, and identify strategic opportunities to improve our data capabilities
Track and evaluate emerging techniques in data curation and generative AI, and make evidence-based recommendations about what to adopt
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience prompting, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs or vision-language/diffusion models for specific downstream tasks
Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), preference optimization (RLHF, DPO), RAG and retrieval-based data curation
Experience designing, evaluating and productionizing data science algorithms used for data curation, data filtering, deduplication and data down-selection.
Experience designing controlled experiments or ablation studies to understand effect of data on model quality
Experience building agentic or multi-agent, tool-using LLM systems and human-in-the-loop workflows, calibrating judges against human labels, and mitigating failure modes
Strong software engineering skills, with 5+ years in Python, workflow orchestration (Airflow), cloud platforms (AWS, GCP), distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, Ray, or similar) at large scale
Publication record or open-source contributions in NLP, computer vision, or generative AI is a plus
Familiarity with privacy-preserving data techniques (e.g., differential privacy, on-device data constraints) is a plus
**Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related engineering field
5+ years of hands-on experience applying NLP, computer vision, or multimodal machine learning to production systems, including experience with large-scale data pipelines
**Pay & Benefits**
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

The Transparency & Observability Data Science team builds the data, metrics, and analytical capabilities that help us understand how our enforcement systems perform. Our work supports both internal decision-making and external transparency reporting, while improving the reliability, explainability, and quality of Trust & Safety data. As a Lead Data Scientist on this team, you will be the technical architect for how Trust & Safety measures, monitors, and explains itself. You will design the systems and data foundations behind our metrics, observability, and transparency reporting, and serve as the AI and data architecture lead who drives AI readiness across Trust & Safety. Responsibilities: - Architect Transparency & Observability Systems: - Establish the Transparency & Observability architecture for Trust & Safety, covering metrics, data pipelines, monitoring, and reporting. - Design end-to-end observability for the enforcement lifecycle, from detection and review to actions and outcomes, so that every enforcement decision can be traced, measured, and explained. - Set standards for metric definitions, anomaly detection, and alerting, and make sure Trust & Safety reports one consistent view of its enforcement. - Build Governed, AI-Ready Data Foundations: - Set up data quality, lineage, and governance practices (SLAs, validation, reconciliation, documentation) so that Trust & Safety data is accurate, timely, and audit-ready for regulatory reporting. - Design and oversee ETL pipelines and workflow orchestration that turn scattered inputs into reliable, well-documented data products. - Build data systems designed for agent consumption across Trust & Safety, covering canonical data models, semantic layers, intelligent workflows, and evals. - Drive AI Readiness and Technical Leadership Across Trust & Safety: - Partner with Product, Engineering, Policy, Operations, Legal, and Comms to find high-impact opportunities where AI and data can improve operational efficiency and safety outcomes, and take solutions from experimentation to reliable production. - Own the long-term technical roadmap for Trust & Safety observability and AI readiness, and lead the program and change management needed to land it across teams. - Create reusable architecture principles, reference architectures, and best practices for responsible, explainable AI adoption across Trust & Safety teams, and mentor data scientists and engineers in applying them.
Qualifications
**Minimum Qualification(s):** - 5+ years of experience in Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Analytics, or a related quantitative field, including technical leadership of cross-team initiatives. - A track record of designing scalable data ecosystems: data modeling, governed analytics layers, and production pipelines on large-scale platforms (e.g. Hive, Spark). - Strong SQL and Python skills. - Experience building data quality, monitoring, or observability solutions, and designing metrics frameworks used across organizations. - A solid understanding of AI architecture patterns (e.g. RAG, embeddings, knowledge systems) and responsible AI practices, applied to operational workflows. - Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into technical strategy, and to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership. - Bachelor's degree or above in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or Economics. Preferred Qualification(s): - Experience in Trust & Safety, regulatory reporting, or compliance domains. - Familiarity with transparency and regulatory requirements such as the EU Digital Services Act (DSA) and similar global frameworks. - Experience driving program and change management across global, cross-functional teams.

item.title: Applied Scientist, Product Policy - OpenAI
item.description:
Product Policy - San Francisco
**About the Team**
The Product Policy research team studies how people use and experience AI product, policy, and safety decisions. We partner with researchers, data scientists, engineers, and cross-functional teams to understand AI’s effects on people’s lives, including well-being, youth experiences, and social and emotional use.
**About the Role**
We’re looking for an Applied Scientist to help design, execute, and analyze large-scale longitudinal research on AI use and well-being. You’ll work closely with research leads to translate scientific questions into rigorous studies, combining survey responses with behavioral data to understand how people’s experiences with AI evolve over time.
This is a hands-on role spanning applied analysis, research methods, and study execution. You’ll build reproducible analytical workflows, assess data quality and representativeness, and help establish reliable infrastructure for ongoing panel research. Your work will support research involving teens and adults, including studies of AI companionship, and help turn findings into useful evidence for product, policy, and safety partners.
**In this role, you will:**
* Partner with research leads to develop study designs, survey measures, and analysis plans for longitudinal research on AI use and well-being. * Conduct statistical analyses of survey and behavioral dataage patterns, and sample representativeness. * Prepare and validate analysis-ready datasets, implement analysis plans, and produce clear summaries and visualizations using reproducible workflows. * Develop quality checks across survey programming, fieldwork, data delivery, and repeated study waves to identify inconsistencies and improve research reliability. * Own day-to-day study execution, coordinating timelines, vendors, and cross-functional dependencies to deliver high-quality research on schedule. * Collaborate with data engineering and privacy partners on responsible account linkage, data flows, logging, and retention. * Support human-subjects research review, including Institutional Review Board (IRB) documentation, protocol amendments, and consent and assent processes. * Maintain clear documentation of methods, measures, assumptions, and protocol changes, and contribute analysis and methodological materials for research readouts, publications, and peer review. * Communicate findings, limitations, and practical recommendations to technical and nontechnical partners, and build reusable tools and processes that improve future studies.
**You might thrive in this role if you:**
* Have experience conducting applied quantitative research in social science, behavioral science, human-computer interaction, statistics, or a related field. * Bring strong foundations in survey research and statistical analysis, with experience working on panel studies, longitudinal datasets, or human-subjects research. * Are comfortable using SQL and Python or R to prepare data, implement analyses, validate results, and create visualizations. * Understand how recruitment, missing data, participant attrition, and measurement choices can affect the interpretation and generalizability of findings. * Can move between analytical work and practical execution, managing multiple timelines and collaborators while maintaining scientific rigor. * Communicate clearly. * Exercise sound judgment when working with sensitive data and research involving minors. * Enjoy building structure in ambiguous environments and collaborating across disciplines.
**Nice to Have**
* Experience combining survey responses with behavioral or product data. * Familiarity with preregistration, measure validation, reproducible research, and academic publication or peer-review processes. * Experience working with research vendorss, or IRB and ethics-review partners. * Research experience related to AI-human interaction, digital well-being, youth development, or social and emotional uses of technology.
**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

item.title: Data Scientist, Product to Market (P2M) Optimization - Gap Inc.
item.description:
**About Gap Inc.** ------------------
At Gap Inc., we create culture as much as we create clothes. Our ambition is to become a high-performing house of iconic American brands that shape culture.
Our portfolio—Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, and Athleta—each brings a distinct point of view to how we show up in the world and serve our customers.
Old Navy democratizes style with quality and value for all. Gap champions originality through essential pieces that celebrate individuality. Banana Republic is rooted in a spirit of discovery, creating modern pieces inspired by craftsmanship and travel. Athleta champions the Power of She through confidence, strength, and movement.
We’re driven by a shared purpose: to bridge gaps—between people, perspectives, and possibilities—to create a better world.
We’re building a team that performs at a high level—people who think boldly, take ownership, and turn ideas into impact. If you’re ready to learn fast and help shape what’s next, you’ll fit right in.
**About the role** ------------------
Gap Inc. is seeking a Data Scientist to join our Product-to-Market (P2M) Data Science team. P2M encompasses the decisions that shape how products move from planning to the customer, including what products to carry, how much inventory to buy, where and how inventory should be positioned, and how products should be priced and promoted. Our team applies machine learning, optimization, and analytics to improve these decisions across P2M lifecycle.This is a hands-on role for someone early in their career who has strong quantitative and programming fundamentals and wants to solve real-world retail problems at scale. The team operates in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve and problems are not always fully defined. Success requires curiosity, initiative, and self-motivation, with a willingness to take ownership, learn quickly, and proactively move work forward. The candidate will work with experienced data scientists and cross-functional partners while building deeper expertise in applied data science and optimization.
**What you'll do** ------------------
* Develop and test machine learning, optimization, and statistical models for retail P2M problems * Analyze large datasets and develop analytical solutions using Python, SQL, and related technologies * Write reliable, maintainable code and contribute to testing, documentation, and code management * Evaluate model performance and support measurement of business impact using appropriate statistical methods * Work with senior data scientists to troubleshoot, improve, and operationalize analytical solutions * Collaborate with business, product, engineering, and data science partners to understand requirements and communicate analytical findings
**Who you are** ---------------
* Master’s degree in Operations Research, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field * 2 to 3 years of experience in data science, machine learning, operations research, or applied analytics * Experience working on retail, supply chain, pricing, inventory, merchandising, or related business problems * Strong foundation in machine learning, statistics, and quantitative problem solving * Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL * Self-motivated with demonstrated initiative and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment * Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills
**Preferred Qualifications** ----------------------------
* Experience with mathematical optimization, including linear or mixed-integer programming, and tools such as Gurobi, Pyomo, OR-Tools, or equivalent * Exposure to PySpark, Databricks, GCP, Git, or production data science environments * Familiarity with experimentation or causal methods for measuring business impact * Exposure to building AI agents or agentic workflows using large language models
**Salary Range:** $146,500.00 - $190,500.00 Employee pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

* *For eligible employees*

item.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer - Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC
item.description:
**Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology**
Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.
The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.
**Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:**
* **Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach, Scale & Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.
Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment & ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity.
The Core ML team is an applied science and machine learning engineering team that owns the core personalization algorithms powering Disney+ and Hulu. Our work spans real-time ranking, content and user understanding, candidate retrieval, and post-ranking, serving recommendations to one of the largest streaming audiences in the world. We operate at the intersection of research and production: we ideate, prototype, validate, and ship, and we are responsible for driving the innovation that moves the personalization experience forward
**Job Summary:**
We are looking for a Lead Machine Learning Engineer to help us ideate, develop, iterate on, and productionize personalization algorithms across the recommendation stack. This includes our core ranking algorithms, content and user understanding models and graphs, as well as candidate retrieval and post-ranking systems.
There is more than one way to be a great fit for this role. You might be a strong applied scientist with sharp intuition for recommendation approaches, evaluation methodology, and how data, features, and objectives shape model behavior. You might be a strong end-to-end ML engineer who can take ideas to production at scale and keep systems healthy, maintainable, and easy to iterate on. Ideally, you bring a blend of both: someone who generates ideas of their own, helps other applied scientists bring theirs to life, and can jump in from either the science or the engineering side when something needs attention.
This is also an opportunity to work at the frontier. We are especially excited about candidates with strong relevant experience (RecSys, ML, AI/LLM) who can help bridge where recommendation systems are today and where the field is heading, applying modern AI techniques not only to improve recommendations themselves, but to improve how we build, evaluate, and iterate on our systems.
In this role, you will help drive the vision and innovation behind Disney's personalization systems, with the goal of delighting our users through great content recommendations, improving customer satisfaction, and deepening our understanding of both content and users.
**Responsibilities:**
* **Algorithm development:** Ideate, develop, iterate on, and productionize personalization algorithms, including core ranking, content and user understanding models and graphs, candidate retrieval, and post-ranking systems. * **AI and LLM innovation:** Apply modern AI and LLM techniques to recommendation systems, including using them to generate and improve recommendations, strengthen system evaluation, and accelerate how we build and improve our models. * **Applied science:** Contribute ideas and insight on recommendation approaches, evaluation methodology, and how we define data, features, and objectives for our models, and help other scientists on the team shape and productionize their ideas. * **Vision and roadmap:** Help drive the technical vision and innovation agenda for personalization, identifying high-impact opportunities and shaping how the team approaches them. * **Experimentation and evaluation:** Design and run rigorous offline and online experiments, and contribute to improving our evaluation systems and methodology. * **Collaboration:** Work closely within the team and across Engineering, Product, and Data partners, communicating methodologies clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and managing stakeholder expectations. * **ML engineering:** Build production-worthy, maintainable systems that are easy to iterate on, uphold strong standards for development, testing, and deployment, and jump in to support when production issues arise.
**:**
**Basic Qualifications**
* 7+ years of experience developing machine learning models and deploying them to production systems * Strong background in applied ML science, end-to-end ML engineering, or ideally a blend of both, with experience in recommendation systems modeling * Hands-on experience with AI and LLM techniques and a solid understanding of the modern AI landscape * Proficiency with tools and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Databricks, Spark, and SQL * In-depth understanding of modern machine learning methods, models, and their mathematical underpinnings * Strong written and verbal communication skills * A collaborative, personable working style; works well within the team and across teams rather than operating in isolation
**Preferred Qualifications**
* PhD in computer science, statistics, math, or a related quantitative field * Publications or papers in machine learning or AI, especially in recommender systems * Production experience developing content recommendation algorithms at scale * Experience with reinforcement learning or related sequential decision-making approaches * Experience with evaluation methodology for recommendation systems, including offline evaluation and A/B experimentation
**Required Education**
* BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

item.title: Principal Applied Scientist, FAIM (Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models) - Amazon.com
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
The FAIM (Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models) builds the agentic AI systems behind next-generation advertising. The team develops multimodal foundation models and LLM-driven agents that power shopper understanding, audience-aware creative generation, and agentic advertising workflows.
As a Principal Applied Scientist for the FAIM team, you will invent the models that help advertisers achieve desired outcomes. Today's state of the art models can setup ad campaigns to a specification, but do not understand advertising strategy well enough to help with abstract goals that real advertisers ask about like "how can I make more money."
This is a rare charter to build foundational optimization science where little exists today, spanning campaign recommendation, cross-product budget allocation, incrementality measurement, and long-term-sales modeling. You will set technical direction for a growing team, partner with engineering and product to take models from research to production at Amazon scale, and directly move advertiser ROAS and new-to-brand growth.
In this role you will
* Own the science vision for training models in our RL Gym from end-to-end * Invent models for joint budget allocation, incrementality, and long-term value * Take innovations from prototype to production serving live advertiser campaigns * Raise the technical bar across scientists and engineers
Key job responsibilities
* Define the long-term scientific vision for our RL Gym based training process focusing on campaign optimization and other advertising workflows * Translating ambiguous advertiser needs and competing objectives into a concrete science roadmap. * Invent, prototype, and productionize machine learning and optimization solutions for joint budget allocation across sponsored ad products, spanning the shopper journey from awareness to purchase. * Develop rigorous approaches to incrementality measurement and long-term-sales modeling that ground optimization in true advertiser value. * Design and lead large-scale experiments and analyses to validate hypotheses and guide product direction. * Partner closely with engineering and product to define technical contracts, data schemas, and serving systems that carry models into production. * Raise the technical bar across science and engineering through mentorship, design reviews, and hands-on collaboration. * Grow scientific talent and publish impactful research internally and at top-tier venues.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field * 5+ years of hands-on experience in predictive modeling and analysis * Experience distilling informal customer requirements into problem definitions while dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python, or related language * Experience leading experienced scientists, as well as a record of developing junior members from academia or industry into a career track in a business environment

item.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - PayPal
item.description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
**Job Summary:**

item.title: Multimodal AI Applied Scientist, SIML - ISE - Apple
item.description:
Apple's System Intelligence and Machine Learning (SIML) team is seeking a Multimodal AI applied scientist to drive the future of multimodal scene understanding and human-centric device interaction. At the heart of this effort, you will develop multimodal LLMs designed to perceive complex environments and understand nuanced human behaviors, preferences, and interactions. This role offers a rare opportunity to join a leading applied research team known for its foundational contributions to Apple Intelligence, where you will work across the entire generative model lifecycle, spanning novel architecture design, model training, and deployment.
**Description**
We are looking for an applied scientist with deep skills in ML and generative modeling to architect, train, and deploy multimodal scene understanding technology that can understand scene from visual and audio data. You will quickly build and demonstrate new user experiences using large foundation models, developing innovative capabilities while partnering with cross-functional teams and iterating rapidly in a dynamic environment.
Your work will advance human interaction and scene understanding modeling across the stack, from system-level architecture to core ML algorithms. Among the many challenges you will address are modeling user behaviors and preferences through device and environmental interactions, retrieving nuanced insights from historical context, handling deeply interleaved streaming data, reasoning across diverse temporal horizons, designing memory systems for long-term adaptation, and learning semantically rich representations for open-ended downstream applications.
You will also be responsible for delivering ML models and solutions that can be readily integrated into production pipelines, such as APIs for production-ready models and algorithms built directly into our training infrastructure.","responsibilities":"Design, train, and deploy large-scale multimodal LLMs, owning the entire lifecycle from initial architecture to final deployment within the constraints.

Experience working with large cross-functional and diverse teams.

item.title: Data Scientist - Trial Surveillance & Analytics (Hybrid) - AbbVie
item.description:
**Company Description**
**About AbbVie**
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
**Job Description**
Trial Surveillance & Analytics (TSA) is a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, statisticians, statistical programmers, and AI specialists in Data & AI Acceleration, part of AbbVie's Data and Statistical Sciences, focused on transforming clinical trial surveillance through AI-enabled data integration, analytics, and automated reporting. TSA delivers integrated medical monitoring and safety surveillance capabilities that enable timely, trusted, and actionable insights across the clinical development lifecycle.
Data Scientists play a key role in designing, developing, and scaling innovative analytics solutions that support clinical trial surveillance, medical monitoring, safety evaluation, and data-driven decision-making. This position combines analytical expertise, business acumen, and modern AI-enabled approaches to transform complex clinical data into meaningful insights that improve operational efficiency and support patient safety. The team is AI-native: agentic coding and AI tools are part of how we program, analyze, and report.
**Responsibilities:**
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to understand surveillance, analytics, and reporting needs and translate them into scalable, fit-for-purpose solutions. * Develop analytical products, automated workflows, and AI-enabled capabilities that support trial surveillance, medical monitoring, and safety assessment activities, including streamlined solutions from data to analytics to reporting. * Apply statistical methodologies, machine learning techniques, and advanced analytics approaches to generate actionable insights from clinical trial data. * Contribute to the development and maintenance of integrated analytics platforms, data pipelines, and reporting solutions that support ongoing monitoring and safety surveillance. * Transform complex clinical and operational data into clear visualizations, decision-support tools, and meaningful business insights for clinical and safety teams. * Apply AI to transform statistical programming: use agentic coding and generative AI to generate, validate, and document code and outputs, contribute to migrating legacy SAS programs to R, and measure resulting efficiency gains. * Collaborate with team members to establish best practices, reusable analytical assets, and standards that ensure high-quality and consistent user experiences. * Support continuous innovation through experimentation, proof-of-concept development, and evaluation of emerging analytical and AI technologies. * Contribute to operational excellence initiatives by identifying opportunities to improve processes, reduce manual effort, and enhance data quality and reporting efficiency. * Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, GCP, ICH guidelines, AbbVie policies, and departmental quality standards.
**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree statistics, analytics, bioinformatics, data science or equivalent field. * 2-5 years of experience in data science, analytics, statistical programming, data engineering, or related disciplines. * Complete or Full / Career proficiency in R, Python or other statistical languages and packages. * Intermediate-level knowledge of statistical and data mining techniques. * Intermediate proficiency with visualization tools such as Spotfire, PyDash/Plotly, or equivalent platforms. * Experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or generative AI technologies to business problems. * Experience developing automated reporting, data products, or end-to-end analytical solutions.
**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Familiarity with clinical data standards (e.g., CDISC SDTM/ADaM) and clinical development processes preferred. * Master’s or PhD degree preferred.
**Other Required Skills:**
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment. * Strong collaboration and communication skills and experience working in cross-functional teams.

item.title: Applied Scientist III, AWS Account Management and Governance - Amazon Web Services
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
We are seeking an Applied Scientist III to own the technical vision and development of an AI-based governance intelligence platform that will redefine how account and organizational governance is defined, validated, and enforced at scale. This mission-critical platform will leverage AI-driven autonomous agents to conduct proactive, intelligent governance operations across the account lifecycle. The platform will integrate deeply with organizational management, identity, and cloud-native control systems to provide self-serve, automated governance insights, policy verification, and enforcement mechanisms. The Governance Foundations team is building a unified governance foundation that consolidates account management controls — including automated enrollment, managed policies, and account lifecycle guardrails — into a single, intelligent, scalable system. As a senior science leader on the team, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy on ambiguous, open-ended problems that span multiple organizations. You will set the multi-year scientific direction, make the architectural and modeling decisions that others build on, and drive alignment across applied science, engineering, product, and partner teams — up to and including senior leadership. This is an opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven governance assurance at enterprise scale: defining standards, influencing company-wide account governance posture, and leading technical innovation at the highest level. Key job responsibilities
* Own and define the next-generation governance intelligence and policy-matching platform, setting the multi-year technical strategy for AI-driven governance automation across applied science and engineering teams and resolving the hardest, most ambiguous problems in the space. * Build on and advance a multi-agent LLM framework for autonomous governance operations, and influence partner organizations to adopt the most promising approaches — including human-in-the-loop enforcement boundaries that cannot be bypassed by autonomous agents. * Develop a highly scalable intelligent governance agent framework — combining traditional ML and LLM-based techniques — that enables internal teams to automate validation, classification, and enforcement across structured and unstructured policy and account data. * Provide technical leadership and scientific mentorship across the broader organization — raising the bar on science quality, growing other scientists and engineers, and representing the team's technical direction to senior leadership — while still diving deep hands-on to diagnose complex system performance and correctness problems in distributed governance control planes. * Define the scientific metrics, evaluation methodology, and quality bar by which the platform's governance decisions are measured and trusted.
About the team
The Accounts Management and Governance team builds the unified governance foundation for account and organizational management at scale. The team consolidates account lifecycle controls, policy propagation, and enforcement guardrails into a single intelligent system, ensuring the experiences Amazon delivers to its customers uphold our highest standards of security, correctness, and operational integrity. The science team harnesses AI to strengthen Amazon's governance posture more efficiently and effectively
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc. * Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

item.title: Senior Data Scientist - Discovery - Roblox
item.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
**WHY DATA SCIENCE & ANALYTICS?** The Data Science & Analytics organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency and acumen of making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. We cover a wide area of the data spectrum including analytical data engineering, product analytics, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modeling and machine learning. Aligned and partnering with product verticals, we use this extensive tool belt to discover new opportunities and unmet use cases, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build data products and measure impact on our community of players and developers.
**WHY DISCOVERY EXPERIENCES?** Roblox is not just a platform; it is a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 70 million daily active users. The **Discovery Experiences** team is the technical heartbeat of this ecosystem. We own the surfaces—Home, Search, Matchmaking, and Notifications—that determine how users navigate the metaverse.
As a **Data Scientist** , you will own the ranking initiatives that power these canvases. You aren't just building models; you are building the economic and social frameworks that decide which experiences thrive. You will report directly to the **Senior Director of Data Science** and serve as a high-visibility IC leader driving the roadmap for our most critical consumer touchpoints.
**You Will**
* Algorithmic Vision: Lead the development of ML solutions and ranking frameworks that power our discovery canvases. You will move beyond local optimizations to solve for long-term ecosystem health and user retention. * Strategic XFN Partnership: Act as the primary scientific advisor to Product and Engineering leaders. You will use data to inform, drive, and accelerate innovations via deep-dive insights and ML prototypes. * Causal Inference & Experimentation: Leverage advanced causal inference methodologies to measure the effectiveness of platform initiatives (e.g., social features or site-wide events) that are often susceptible to complex network effects. * Foundational Scaling: Develop frameworks to scale the hypothesis generation process, ensuring that our experimentation velocity matches our massive growth. * First-Principles Problem Solving: Apply creative, first-principles reasoning to ambiguous problems, such as balancing the visibility of established "top tier" experiences with the discovery of new, niche UGC content.
**You Have**
* Advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in a quantitative field (Statistics, CS, Physics, Applied Math, or Economics). * 4+ years of experience (or 2+ with a PhD) in Data Science, Economics, or ML Engineering, specifically within large-scale recommendation systems or UGC content platforms. * Expert in the modern data stack (Python, R, SQL, Hive, Spark, Airflow) and have a deep theoretical and practical understanding of Deep Learning. * Ability to design sophisticated experiments that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace and social network effects. * Ability to distill high-dimensional problems into succinct, actionable narratives for non-technical executive audiences.

All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on **this page** .

$193,170—$263,670 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

item.title: Senior Data Scientist I, Real World Evidence (RWE), Life Sciences R&D - Tempus AI
item.description:
**Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?** Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.
The Real World Evidence (RWE) group within the Life Sciences R&D team at Tempus works with major pharmaceutical partners to provide best-in-class data, analysis, and methodological guidance for Tempus’s real-world data offering.
We are seeking a highly motivated and solutions-oriented RWE Sr. Data Scientist I with experience and interest in oncology and epidemiological study design to join our team. This role requires the ability to lead observational studies, derive insights from complex real-world clinical data, implement advanced statistical methods, and leverage cutting-edge AI tools to scale tasks and augment insights.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Pharma Collaboration & Strategy: Lead the design and execute delivery of RWE analyses for key pharma clients. You will be responsible for translating complex drug development questions and into actionable research plans that use Tempus data for trial design and outcomes research. * Real World Data Expertise: Lead the derivation of complex real-world endpoints using extensive coding, demonstrating deep comprehension of Tempus clinical and molecular data structures and complexity, while also serving as an expert on the methodological nuances and limitations of real-world data. * Methodology & Platform Contribution: Build technical standards for the team, staying up-to-date on methodological advancements in real-world studies (e.g., causal inference, survival analysis) and oncology guidelines (NCCN and ongoing clinical trials). Contribute to reusable code and internal packages that can be applied across multiple collaborations. * AI & LLM Innovation: Incorporate LLMs, agentic workflows and other AI tools into day-to-day workflows to accelerate code development, discovery, documentation, review, and insight generation. * Scientific Interpretation & Communication: Interpret results of RWE analyses to draw appropriate inferences based on study design/statistical methods, while also evaluating study limitations. Communicate complex methods and results clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Prepare and present internal reports, external-facing deliverables, and, where appropriate, manuscripts or conference materials. * Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal product, oncology, and clinical abstraction, and real-world data science teams to continually enhance Tempus data quality, products, and analytical best practice. You will proactively identify gaps in current products and ensure that customer feedback is represented in development of new products. * Oncology & RWE Domain Expertise: Grow and maintain deep expertise in oncology clinical guidelines (e.g., NCCN) and emerging RWE methodologies.
**Minimum Qualifications**
* Education: Education in epidemiology, biostatistics, data science, public health, or a related field, to the level of either:
+ PhD and 2+ years of additional work experience + Master’s degree and 4+ years of additional work experience
* Technical and Statistical Proficiency
+ Expert-level proficiency with observational real-world healthcare data, including analytical experience with time-to-event methodologies (survival analysis). + Proven expertise in executing RWD analytical studies. + Proficient in using R and SQL, especially statistical tools and packages. + Proficiency applying machine learning, LLM-based coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) and agentic frameworks to support data analysis, code review, or scientific documentation workflows. + Adherence to good software engineering practices (version control, modular code, documentation). + Experience with code review.
* Communication & Client Focus: Demonstrated experience interfacing with clients, showcasing adeptness in presenting and tailoring messaging to a variety of stakeholders. * Soft Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong project management skills. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment working with multi-disciplinary scientists on complex problems.
**Preferred Skillsets**
* Experience working with Pharma or drug development. * Experience in clinical trial design (particularly Phase II-III) in the clinical development space. * Analytical proficiency with claims, EHR, or registry data. * Practical experience building, fine-tuning, or configuring LLM-based tools and agentic workflows specifically for scientific discovery. * Knowledge of oncology guidelines (e.g., NCCN). * Significant experience analyzing biomarker, genomic, or other high-dimensional molecular data alongside clinical datasets. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or BigQuery and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

item.title: Senior Data Scientist, ML— Fraud Prevention - Adobe
item.description:
Senior Data Scientist, ML— Fraud Detection & Effectiveness
**The Opportunity** We are seeking an experienced **Senior** **Machine Learning Data Scientist** to build **fraud and abuse detection models** and measure how effectively they work. This role combines hands-on modeling with deep experimentation, evaluation, and analytics to improve detection and quantify business impact.
You will work across the fraud lifecycle — from modeling and ground-truth definition to performance measurement, monitoring, and executive-ready insights!
What you'll Do
* Build and tune ML models for fraud and abuse detection using statistical and classical ML techniques. * Develop robust evaluation frameworks, datasets, and metrics to measure model and mitigation effectiveness. * Analyze false positives/negatives, model drift, and emerging fraud patterns to continuously improve detection. * Define ground truth, labeling approaches, and fraud taxonomies that support reliable model development and evaluation. * Design experiments and evaluate tradeoffs across precision, recall, customer impact, and fraud loss. * Build dashboards and metrics that translate detection performance into measurable business impact. * Pressure-test models and data for leakage, bias, data-quality issues, and other sources of misleading results. * Partner across engineering, product, policy, and risk teams to turn insights into detection improvements and business decisions.
What you'll need to succeed
* 8+ years in applied Data Science / ML, with experience building and evaluating production ML models. * Strong foundation in statistical and classical ML, experimentation, model evaluation, and performance measurement. * Strong hands-on Python and SQL skills working with large, complex datasets. * Experience with model monitoring, drift, false-positive/false-negative analysis, and imperfect or delayed labels. * Strong data visualization and storytelling skills — able to translate complex analysis into clear insights and recommendations. * Strong analytical judgment, ownership, and ability to operate independently through ambiguity. * Bachelor's or equivalent experience in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field; advanced degree a plus.
**Preferred Attributes**
* Experience in fraud, abuse, risk, identity, trust & safety, or other adversarial domains. * Experience with anomaly detection, clustering, behavioral modeling, or prevalence estimation. * Experience with labeling frameworks, weak supervision, active learning, or human-review systems. * Familiarity with LLMs and AI-assisted evaluation/analysis. * Experience evaluating multi-layered risk controls and automated decisioning systems.
